summary.intent: Run the mandatory SDK E2E test gate and complete the Secure step for GSD phase 71 (share-invite security and IPNS data integrity API), then commit the phase security review.
summary.outcome: Verified SDK E2E prerequisites (postgres, kubo/IPFS, redis, mock-ipns-routing) were up and confirmed the missing THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET wouldn't cause failures since NODE_ENV=test relaxes throttling; kicked off the full E2E gate as a background job. Separately, Step 2 (Secure) closed 12/12 threats with one accepted residual risk (T-71-02), and 71-SECURITY.md was committed after confirming the root SECURITY.md was untouched.

repo: Rate-limit throttling is relaxed under NODE_ENV=test, so a missing THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET in apps/api/.env does not cause 429s during SDK E2E runs.
A secret-pattern guard blocks direct grepping of .env files via Bash; throttle bypass behavior had to be inferred from source instead.

code.finding: Throttle limits are gated/relaxed when NODE_ENV=test, which is how the API runs during SDK E2E tests.

workflow: Full SDK E2E gate requires prereqs on fixed ports: postgres 5432, IPFS/kubo 5001, redis 6380, mock-ipns-routing 3001, plus TEST_LOGIN_SECRET.
The gate is run as one long background job: rebuild the client chain (to match CI dist), restart the API from fresh dist, run the suite with aligned secrets, then shut the API down (~5-8 min).

friction: THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET missing from apps/api/.env required extra investigation to confirm it wasn't actually needed.
Secret-pattern guard blocked a direct .env grep, forcing a source-code-only investigation path.
open_items: THROTTLE_BYPASS_SECRET remains absent from apps/api/.env (currently harmless under NODE_ENV=test, but worth adding for parity with CI/prod-like runs).
SDK E2E gate result not yet confirmed in this excerpt — job was still running in the background at time of transcript.
T-71-02 (client-asserted rootNodeId) remains an accepted, documented residual risk (D-02) rather than a closed threat.
